usedFor: Lofty holds leads and transactions, and Google Docs records each “New Lead Created” via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Lofty, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new lead from a selected list is written to a doc tab as soon as it exists.

watchOut: “Updated Lead” runs on every update and the action can replace a tab, so test before relying on it.
